facts.fact: 门球外交：与 ost Vonlins 的「会面」=后院草坪门球赛 anteroque（木槌+机械彩球、球间互射小箭 sabotage、 tepid applause）——「Keep your petitioner impatient」的开局；Lorz（长、金链满身、戒上有 Lumin familiar）、Rorik（中、巨汉、谈吐含混、单指转槌）、Faün（幼、剑士体格如 Cosima、沉默皱眉——曾提议「决斗」被 Lorz 否）；Ulshära 戴面具=「提醒众人她才是神权在握者」
facts.anchor: manner of lawn game called anteroque

facts.fact: 战况回顾：Dante 双角术后昏迷——Ulshära「A demon……My posturing at the execution has spurred the ost Vonlins to request a meeting」；Cosima 悲凉「The things a brother would do for his sister」；「他们必然还在造兵——多半去 Divine City 领更多羽毛；希望能找到 leverage 劝阻——届时少一个障碍」；Risha「Dante 醒来可潜入 Aphelion Tower 查 Dawn Throne 图纸」（提及 legionnaires 时手颤）；Angelica 望其新角想 Yvri——「若毁 fulcrum 则神灭，那龙算什么？Deia 会去寻他吗？」
facts.anchor: My posturing at the execution has spurred the ost Vonlins to request a meeting.

facts.fact: Risha 摊牌：Lorz 谄「你们高效处置了 Starscourge 之子」+「一句话我们可供应任意多 legionnaires」——Risha 拍案「Why are we stalling? 你们的军团侵我领域、杀我人民——They killed my father, Rath Vakara, head of my House. This will not go without consequences.」——借口「奉神命不得不」；她的影子里长出深紫 petunias（Angelica 悄悄踏灭）
facts.anchor: They killed my father, Rath Vakara, head of my House.

facts.fact: Angelica 演说：「你们的生意是战争——但与我们为敌毫无意义：这些苦难是 Phos 的决定挑起的……连 Sunslayer 的行为也只是对他的回应；那些有家人战友爱人的士兵在他眼里不过是 fodder——He is using your elite as kindling, burning them out on their own power only to gain an inch of stolen ground；他也会这样用你们；连 Kaspan 死后祂都不让安息」；额头发烧、内在声（她自己的声音非 Deia）「Words are not as potent as action」——指甲掐掌压念
facts.anchor: He is using your elite as kindling

facts.fact: Noctus 转嫁：Ulshära 证实「Phos 占 Kaspan 之躯后欲夺 Varrick 为 vessel——为征服弃最珍贵资源」「我有 clarity、favors——只要停止造兵，哪怕只为给 Sunslayer 减少目标」；Lorz 反咬「惩罚应更重——为何不反击生下叛神者的领域？」+「若谈成 Vitae 停战，以转攻 Noctus 为交换（其恶神正再次荼毒我土）」——「来止一场战争，却接续了另一场」；内在声「You can end them… See their pretty grasses burned… They do not yet know what it means to be razed.」

Oskar 交易：Lorz 咀嚼杯沿花瓣——「你们与 Oskar ost Krülin 是亲？Krülins 家为 Varrick 家造过不少利器（最著者 arquebuses）——我们愿 patronize 这位 Deviser，只要他挣得起供养」「可他已拒绝过你们」「Ah, but it wouldn't be us petitioning him. It will be you, Imperator. Just like last time.」；Angelica 补刀「况且 Ulshära 本就深谙 Devising 之道」——Faún 冷笑、Ulshära flinch；事后解释是 bluff「We're just buying time.」——Ulshära 怒「Oskar 永不会为他们造武器，Phos 亲令也不会」+「Then use that time wisely.」
facts.anchor: It will be you, Imperator. Just like last time.

facts.fact: 琴疗：无 Yvri 则够不了元素之门（连 aether 三音也烫）「Is it because we're separated? 也许他一直在替她充当 conduit——履行神之 fulcrum 的本分」；「I thought I was getting better——孩子般可怜的语气让她羞耻」；Cosima「Play for me.」——她如握毒蛇持琴；「每支曲子把她拆开重排——颈与肘、大腿与肩、每一个不讨喜却必要的升降音——像 famine 之人摘果；而这场饥荒是她自己造的」；奏至火自体升腾、欲望退潮——「dark hands parted through her dancing flames and held her waist」；「食之神圣：咬过憎恶之人的血铁、神之圣肉——一是恐怖一是异端；咬 Cosima 则是 hallowed……feast laid out in offering to an insatiable deity」；教琴两音=她哼给 Cosima 的曲子开头
facts.anchor: Each song bisected her and rearranged her parts

facts.fact: 火烧神羽：Cosima 灵光「Phos 被烧走是因羽毛焚毁；Varrick 断臂保命——若烧掉 Ulshära 的羽毛呢？We make your power useful.」；Ulshära 私室（帘幕遮尽日光、皮咬带）「Even if he does, I cannot allow him to use me. I will not live in fear. Do it.」；Angelica 奉火贴其肩「fed her greed」、Ulshära 环皮革惨嚎不动；Phos 之音「There is no escape from me.」；她借第三眼微缝压过神光——羽黑化成灰；Ulshära 肩上留下「与 Deia 在 Angelica 臂上几乎相同的掌印」；Risha 治愈「It's gone. It's gone.」「Thank you.」；「保护的价格也许永远是疼痛」
facts.anchor: That bore a handprint almost exactly like the one Deia had left on Angelica.
